bio: Situated in a panoramic and picturesque location outside the town centre, Principe Leopoldo is the gourmet restaurant of a classic-style hotel with an intimate ambience. Take a seat on the veranda with its stunning views of the lake and mountains or make yourself comfortable in the elegant dining room in winter. The cuisine here is based on solid traditional technique and is prepared from seasonal local and Mediterranean ingredients, with an equal balance of meat and fish dishes. The wine list has something for all tastes, including a selection of memorable vintages....
